proves.claim: A screen job a sprint submission starts through runScreenJob writes its result step and then ends at done with no lease.

api.gate.screen-done.ends-in-done.why: A screen job that stops at its result step reads as open forever, so fixtures waiting for every job to be done hang.

proves.claim: Open-job counts and lease sweeps no longer see a finished screen job, and a steady submission makes no screen job.

api.gate.screen-done.unseen-when-finishe.why: Without this test a finished screen job could hold a lapsed lease that sweeps and open counts read as stalled work.
